title: Not Learning from Others
title_zh: 不向他人学习
title_primary: 不向他人学习
title_secondary: Not Learning from Others
authors: John Conlon, Malavika Mani, Gautam Rao, Matthew Ridley, Frank Schilbach
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study social learning using experiments where two people independently learn relevant information and can share it to make accurate private decisions. Across three experiments, people are substantially less sensitive to information others discover than to equally-relevant information they discovered themselves. This holds when they must learn information from others through discussion; when the experimenter perfectly communicates the information; and even when participants observe others’ information with their own eyes. Our results therefore stem not from a failure to elicit information from others but a systematic tendency to underweight it relative to one’s own information. Our findings illustrate a powerful barrier to social learning that might underlie many documented cases of failure to learn from others.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究社会学习，其中两人独立获取相关信息，并可分享这些信息以做出准确的私人决策。在三个实验中，人们对他人发现的信息的敏感度远低于对自身发现的同等相关信息。这一现象在以下情况下均成立：当人们必须通过讨论从他人处学习信息时；当实验者完美传达信息时；甚至当参与者亲眼目睹他人的信息时。因此，我们的结果并非源于未能从他人处获取信息，而是源于一种系统性的倾向，即相对于自身信息，人们会低估他人信息。我们的发现揭示了社会学习中的一个强大障碍，这可能解释了诸多记录在案的学习他人失败的案例。

title: Gender and Culture
title_zh: 性别与文化
title_primary: 性别与文化
title_secondary: Gender and Culture
authors: Paola Giuliano, Max Posch, Itzchak Tzachi Raz, Francesco Agostinelli, Matthias Doepke 等
official: 官方在线 2020-08-19 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper reviews the literature on gender and culture. Gender gaps in various outcomes (competitiveness, labor force participation, and performance in mathematics, amongst many others) show remarkable differences across countries and tend to persist over time. The economics literature initially explained these differences by looking at standard economic variables such as the level of development, women’s education, the expansion of the service sector, and discrimination. More recent literature has argued that gender differences in a variety of outcomes could reflect underlying cultural values and beliefs. This article reviews the literature on the relevance of culture in the determination of different forms of gender gap. I examine how differences in historical situations could have been relevant in generating gender differences and the conditions under which gender norms tend to be stable or to change over time, emphasizing the role of social learning. Finally, I review the role of different forms of cultural transmission in shaping gender differences, distinguishing between channels of vertical transmission (the role of the family), horizontal transmission (the role of peers), and oblique transmission (the role of teachers or role models).
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了关于性别与文化的文献。在多种结果（如竞争力、劳动力参与率、数学表现等）中，性别差距在不同国家间显示出显著差异，并往往随时间持续存在。经济学文献最初通过考察标准经济变量，如发展水平、女性教育、服务业扩张及歧视，来解释这些差异。而更近期的文献则认为，各种结果中的性别差异可能反映了深层的文化价值观和信念。本文回顾了关于文化在决定不同形式性别差距中相关性的文献。我探讨了历史情境差异如何可能促成性别差异的产生，以及性别规范在何种条件下趋于稳定或随时间变化，并强调了社会学习的作用。最后，我回顾了不同形式的文化传播在塑造性别差异中的作用，区分了垂直传播（家庭的作用）、水平传播（同伴的作用）和斜向传播（教师或榜样的作用）等渠道。

title: The Federal Reserve’s Evolving Interpretation and Implementation of Its Mandate
title_zh: 美联储对其职责的演变性解读与实施
title_primary: 美联储对其职责的演变性解读与实施
title_secondary: The Federal Reserve’s Evolving Interpretation and Implementation of Its Mandate
authors: Athanasios Orphanides
official: 官方在线 2024-11-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Throughout its history, the Fed has operated with a muddled mandate that has not explicitly recognized price stability as the primary goal of monetary policy. The Fed’s success in maintaining price stability and fostering the good economic performance associated with it has depended on how it interpreted its mandate and implemented its policy strategy. In the 1970s and in the recent past, the Fed interpreted its mandate in an overambitious fashion, placing undue emphasis on the elusive goal of maximum employment. On both occasions, the Fed’s strategy proved insufficiently resilient, and high inflation followed. To improve its policy strategy the Fed ought to revert to earlier interpretations of its mandate that acknowledge the primacy of price stability as a policy guide.
abstract_zh: 纵观其历史，美联储一直在一个模糊不清的使命下运作，该使命并未明确承认价格稳定是货币政策的首要目标。美联储在维持价格稳定及促进与之相关的良好经济表现方面的成功，取决于它如何解读其使命并实施其政策策略。在20世纪70年代及近期，美联储以过于雄心勃勃的方式解读其使命，过度强调最大化就业这一难以捉摸的目标。在这两次情况下，美联储的策略均显示出韧性不足，随之而来的是高通胀。为改进其政策策略，美联储应回归早期对其使命的解读，承认价格稳定作为政策指导的首要地位。

title: Too Much Finance Redux
title_zh: 金融过度化再探
title_primary: 金融过度化再探
title_secondary: Too Much Finance Redux
authors: Jean-Louis Arcand, Enrico Berkes, Ugo Panizza
official: 官方在线 2026-03-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper revisits the "too much finance" hypothesis by reassessing the relationship between financial depth and economic growth using an expanded dataset (1960 - 2019) and a systematic estimation strategy that avoids reliance on any single, potentially arbitrary sample window. We estimate both cross-sectional and panel models for all feasible starting periods and focus on transparent specifications. We find a robust inverted-U relationship between private credit and growth: financial depth is growth-enhancing at low and moderate levels but exhibits diminishing returns and eventually becomes negative at high levels. The turning point generally lies between 70 and 120 percent of GDP, almost always below the 90th percentile of the global distribution of credit to the private sector.
abstract_zh: 本文通过重新评估金融深度与经济增长之间的关系，对“金融过度”假说进行了再审视。我们利用扩展的数据集（1960-2019年）及一种系统性的估计策略，避免依赖任何单一、可能武断的样本窗口。我们针对所有可行的起始时期，估计了横截面模型和面板模型，并侧重于透明的规格设定。研究发现，私人信贷与增长之间存在稳健的倒U型关系：金融深度在低至中等水平时促进增长，但表现出边际收益递减，并在高水平时最终转为负效应。转折点通常位于GDP的70%至120%之间，几乎总是低于全球私人部门信贷分布的90百分位数。

title: Long-Run Effects of H-1B Immigration on the U.S. Economy
title_zh: H-1B移民对美国经济的长期影响
title_primary: H-1B移民对美国经济的长期影响
title_secondary: Long-Run Effects of H-1B Immigration on the U.S. Economy
authors: Ran Abramitzky, Leah Platt Boustan, Ahmet Gulek, Jens Hainmueller
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the effects of H-1B immigration on U.S. industries that employ H-1B workers and their trading partners. Using a novel cross-industry design and the 1999–2003 expansion of the H-1B visa cap for identification, we find that H-1B exposure raised incomes for natives and pre-existing immigrants, with gains concentrated in non-STEM occupations. Income gains propagate forward through supply chains to downstream industries but not backward to upstream industries, consistent with a productivity shock rather than a labor supply shock. We find no direct effect on patenting, suggesting that productivity gains arise from better task execution rather than patentable invention.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了H-1B移民对雇佣H-1B工人的美国行业及其贸易伙伴的影响。利用新颖的跨行业设计，并以1999-2003年H-1B签证上限的扩大作为识别依据，我们发现H-1B暴露提高了本土居民及先前移民的收入，且收益集中在非STEM职业。收入增长通过供应链向前传导至下游行业，但未向后传导至上游行业，这与生产率冲击而非劳动力供给冲击的特征相符。我们未发现对专利活动的直接影响，这表明生产率提升源于更好的任务执行，而非可专利的发明创造。

title: Coherent shocks: External identification and internal validation with an application to geopolitical risk
title_zh: 一致性冲击：外部识别与内部验证——以地缘政治风险为例
title_primary: 一致性冲击：外部识别与内部验证——以地缘政治风险为例
title_secondary: Coherent shocks: External identification and internal validation with an application to geopolitical risk
authors: Yves Schüler, Sarah Arndt, Yevheniia Bondarenko, Vivien Lewis, Matthias Rottner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We propose the concept of coherent shocks: externally identified shocks whose structural interpretation is independently validated within the empirical model. Using textual data, we classify articles by economic mechanism and construct mechanism-specific shock proxies. Our coherence criterion measures the posterior share of impulse-response draws matching the assigned signature, benchmarked against its prior share. Applied to geopolitical risk (GPR), we use a large language model to construct supply-type and demand-type GPR series. Shocks identified from both series are strongly coherent with their assigned signatures. Innovations in the overall GPR index blend the two, and neither recursive nor sign-restriction identification separates them. The criterion applies to any externally identified shock for which theory implies a response signature.
abstract_zh: 我们提出“一致性冲击”概念：指那些结构性解释在经验模型中得到独立验证的外部识别冲击。通过文本数据，我们按经济机制对文章进行分类，并构建特定机制的冲击代理变量。我们的一致性标准衡量了与指定特征匹配的脉冲响应后验占比，并以先验占比为基准进行校准。应用于地缘政治风险（GPR）时，我们利用大语言模型构建供给型与需求型GPR序列。从两个序列中识别的冲击均与其指定特征高度一致。整体GPR指数的创新混合了两种类型，且递归识别与符号约束识别均无法将其分离。该标准适用于任何理论隐含响应特征的外部识别冲击。

title: Interdependent‐value auctions with spiteful bidders
title_zh: 恶意竞拍者参与的相互依赖价值拍卖
title_primary: 恶意竞拍者参与的相互依赖价值拍卖
title_secondary: Interdependent‐value auctions with spiteful bidders
authors: Matthew J. Robertson
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I study the interaction between spiteful preferences and interdependent values in auctions. While spite causes overbidding in both auction formats, interdependent values affect spiteful bidders' incentives differently depending on the auction format. Relative to independent values, bidders with interdependent values are less affected by spite in first‐price auctions, but more affected in second‐price auctions: the decrease in bid shading is smaller in the former, while the increase in above‐value bidding is greater in the latter. This format‐dependent behaviour reflects the trade‐off between increased competitiveness driven by spite and caution induced by the winner's curse.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了拍卖中恶意偏好与相互依存价值的交互作用。尽管恶意行为在两种拍卖形式中均导致过度出价，但相互依存价值对恶意竞拍者激励的影响因拍卖形式而异。相较于独立价值，具有相互依存价值的竞拍者在第一价格拍卖中受恶意影响较小，但在第二价格拍卖中受恶意影响更大：前者中出价折扣的降幅较小，而后者中高于价值出价的增幅较大。这种依赖于拍卖形式的行为，反映了恶意驱动的竞争性增强与赢家诅咒引发的谨慎性之间的权衡。

title: Income interdependence and informal risk sharing under the shadow of the future
title_zh: 未来阴影下的收入相互依赖与非正式风险分担
title_primary: 未来阴影下的收入相互依赖与非正式风险分担
title_secondary: Income interdependence and informal risk sharing under the shadow of the future
authors: Paan Jindapon, Pacharasut Sujarittanonta, Ajalavat Viriyavipart
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We analyze the effects of income interdependence between two players on risk sharing without commitment in an infinitely repeated game. In theory, the likelihood that an informal risk-sharing agreement is self-enforcing decreases with income correlation due to a higher probability of both players being in the same income state in future periods. We test this prediction in a laboratory setting, using treatments with negative, zero, and positive income correlation. Contrary to expectations, we find the least engagement in risk-sharing activities in the zero-correlation treatment. This surprising result suggests that when incomes are positively correlated, experiencing similar financial outcomes fosters a social bond that enhances the success of informal risk-sharing mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了无限重复博弈中，两位参与者之间的收入相互依赖对无承诺风险分担的影响。理论上，由于未来时期两位参与者处于相同收入状态的概率更高，非正式风险分担协议自我执行的可能性会随着收入相关性的增加而降低。我们在实验室环境中检验了这一预测，采用了负相关、零相关和正相关三种收入相关性处理。与预期相反，我们发现零相关处理中风险分担活动的参与度最低。这一令人惊讶的结果表明，当收入呈正相关时，经历相似的财务结果会促进社会纽带，从而增强非正式风险分担机制的成功率。

title: Reducing cropland requirement by optimizing provincial grain trade patterns in China
title_zh: 优化中国省级粮食贸易格局以减少耕地需求
title_primary: 优化中国省级粮食贸易格局以减少耕地需求
title_secondary: Reducing cropland requirement by optimizing provincial grain trade patterns in China
authors: Xin Xuan, Yuping Bai, Xiangzheng Deng, Yecui Hu, Fan Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Optimizing grain trade patterns to conserve cropland is crucial for enhancing the “internal circulation” of grain production. This study characterized the current supply and demand dynamics for China’s three primary staple crops—wheat, maize, and rice—encompassing demand for human consumption, animal feed, and food loss and waste across the entire food supply chain. We developed a linear programming-based grain trade simulation and optimization model to determine the interprovincial trade patterns of these three crops and their virtual cropland trade structure, to assess the potential reduction in cropland requirements achieved by optimizing interprovincial grain trade patterns. We found that in profit-driven trade schemes, grain trade largely follows the principle of proximity, and major grain-producing provinces such as Henan, Shandong, and Anhui alleviate cropland resource imbalances to some extent through interprovincial trade. Optimizing trade patterns could reduce national cropland requirements by nearly 15,000 km2. Attention should also be paid to the synergistic benefits of reducing cropland requirements and reducing transport-related carbon emissions. Optimizing the grain trade structure and leveraging the production advantages of major grain-producing regions contribute to reducing cropland requirement, while simultaneously enhancing the role of land resource management in guaranteeing a stable food supply.
abstract_zh: 优化粮食贸易格局以保护耕地，对于增强粮食生产的“内循环”至关重要。本研究刻画了中国三大主要口粮作物——小麦、玉米和水稻——当前的供需动态，涵盖了人类消费需求、动物饲料需求以及整个食品供应链中的粮食损失与浪费。我们构建了一个基于线性规划的粮食贸易模拟与优化模型，以确定这三种作物的省际贸易格局及其虚拟耕地贸易结构，旨在评估通过优化省际粮食贸易格局所能实现的耕地需求减少潜力。研究发现，在利润驱动的贸易方案下，粮食贸易大体遵循就近原则，河南、山东和安徽等粮食主产省通过省际贸易在一定程度上缓解了耕地资源的不平衡。优化贸易格局可使全国耕地需求减少近15000平方公里。同时，应关注减少耕地需求与降低运输相关碳排放的协同效益。优化粮食贸易结构并发挥粮食主产区的生产优势，有助于减少耕地需求，同时增强土地资源管理在保障稳定粮食供应中的作用。

title: The Value(s) of Women Artists
title_zh: 女性艺术家的价值
title_primary: 女性艺术家的价值
title_secondary: The Value(s) of Women Artists
authors: Renée Adams
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: I use data on values to challenge the belief that women produce art of lower value. Using occupational data in the European Social Survey (ESS) and OLS regressions, I show that women are more likely to be artists in more gender-equal countries, a pattern consistent with greater barriers to artistic careers for women than for men. Using data on Schwartz human values in the ESS, I then show that women artists, particularly those with children, appear to have more exceptional artistic value profiles than their male counterparts. These findings highlight the risks of equating market price with artistic value and underscore the importance of investing in women’s art and women artists. An analysis of curators’ values suggests that market-based strategies alone—such as art collecting—are insufficient to address art-market inequality. Instead, they must be complemented by cultural policies that dismantle structural barriers, including mistaken beliefs.
abstract_zh: 我利用价值观数据挑战了“女性创作的艺术价值更低”这一观念。基于欧洲社会调查（ESS）中的职业数据及OLS回归分析，研究表明在性别更平等的国家中，女性更可能成为艺术家，这一模式与女性在艺术职业中面临比男性更大障碍的现状相符。随后，通过分析ESS中施瓦茨人类价值观数据，我发现女性艺术家（尤其是有子女者）的价值观特征比男性同行更显卓越艺术特质。这些发现揭示了将市场价格等同于艺术价值的风险，并强调了投资女性艺术及女性艺术家的重要性。对策展人价值观的分析表明，仅依靠市场策略（如艺术收藏）不足以解决艺术市场的不平等问题，必须辅以消除结构性障碍（包括错误观念）的文化政策。

title: Government-led green finance and enterprise green transformation: an empirical study of China’s government green fund policy
title_zh: 政府引导的绿色金融与企业绿色转型：基于中国政府绿色基金政策的实证研究
title_primary: 政府引导的绿色金融与企业绿色转型：基于中国政府绿色基金政策的实证研究
title_secondary: Government-led green finance and enterprise green transformation: an empirical study of China’s government green fund policy
authors: Yiran Li, Siliang Liu, Beilei Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The Government Green Fund (GGF) has emerged as an important policy instrument for promoting green and low-carbon development and advancing the broader green transformation of the economy and society. Using a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2010 to 2022, this study manually collects firm-level GGF data and employs a difference-in-differences (DID) approach to evaluate the impact of GGF on enterprise green transformation (EGT). The results indicate that GGF significantly promotes EGT. Further channel analyses suggest that the effect of GGF is consistent with two potential channels: green signalling and the alleviation of financing constraints. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that the effect of GGF on EGT is more pronounced among firms in non-heavily polluting industries, non-state-owned enterprises, and non-growth-stage firms. Furthermore, GGF has a significantly stronger effect in regions with greater government fundraising capacity, and its positive effect on EGT is statistically more significant in regions with lower government environmental attention. In addition, GGF has a stronger effect in non-key support industries. Accordingly, efforts should be made to improve the incentive compatibility mechanism of GGF investment and to implement differentiated investment strategies to enhance the efficiency of capital allocation.
abstract_zh: 政府绿色基金（GGF）已成为推动绿色低碳发展、促进经济社会全面绿色转型的重要政策工具。本文以2010—2022年中国A股上市公司为样本，手工收集企业层面GGF数据，采用双重差分法（DID）评估GGF对企业绿色转型（EGT）的影响。结果表明，GGF显著促进了企业绿色转型。进一步渠道分析表明，GGF的作用与绿色信号传递和融资约束缓解两个潜在渠道一致。异质性分析进一步揭示，GGF对非重污染行业企业、非国有企业及非成长期企业的绿色转型效应更为显著。此外，在政府筹资能力更强的地区，GGF的促进作用更为突出；而在政府环境关注度较低的地区，GGF对EGT的正向效应在统计上更为显著。同时，GGF在非重点支持行业中的效应更强。据此，应完善GGF投资的激励相容机制，并实施差异化投资策略以提升资本配置效率。

title: Foreign direct investment, global value chains, and labor rights: No race-to-the-bottom?
title_zh: 外国直接投资、全球价值链与劳工权利：没有逐底竞争？
title_primary: 外国直接投资、全球价值链与劳工权利：没有逐底竞争？
title_secondary: Foreign direct investment, global value chains, and labor rights: No race-to-the-bottom?
authors: Hyejoon Im, John McLaren
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Does globalization weaken worker’s rights? Data is inconclusive; what evidence there is suggests a developing country tends to strengthen labor rights when its access to global value chains (GVC’s) increases. We present a stylized model of multinational firms choosing host locations for global value chains, in which each host-country government chooses the strength of collective-bargaining rights for its workers. Each government trades the direct benefit of stronger bargaining rights against the effect of chasing multinationals away to rival countries. We find that an increase in globalization in the sense of lower transaction costs has no effect on equilibrium workers’ rights, but lower costs for one country tend to strengthen that country’s labor rights, and adding more countries to the global economy tends, in the limit, to weaken them.
abstract_zh: 全球化是否会削弱工人的权利？现有数据尚无定论；已有的证据表明，当发展中国家融入全球价值链（GVCs）的程度提高时，其往往倾向于加强劳动权利。我们构建了一个模型，描述跨国公司选择全球价值链东道国位置的过程，其中每个东道国政府决定其工人集体谈判权利的强度。每个政府都在加强谈判权利的直接利益与将跨国公司驱赶至竞争对手国家的影响之间进行权衡。我们发现，以降低交易成本为表现的全球化增强，对均衡状态下的工人权利没有影响；但某一国家成本的降低倾向于加强该国的劳动权利，而全球经济中增加更多国家，在极限情况下，则倾向于削弱这些权利。

title: Synergies in Agricultural Biodiversity Conservation: Decomposing the Interaction Between Nature Parks and Agri‐Environment Schemes
title_zh: 农业生物多样性保护中的协同效应：自然公园与农业环境计划交互作用的分解
title_primary: 农业生物多样性保护中的协同效应：自然公园与农业环境计划交互作用的分解
title_secondary: Synergies in Agricultural Biodiversity Conservation: Decomposing the Interaction Between Nature Parks and Agri‐Environment Schemes
authors: Yanbing Wang, Christian Ritzel, Antonia Kaiser, Gabriele Mack
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Understanding how policy instruments with overlapping goals interact is crucial for leveraging their synergies. This study explores the mechanisms for regional nature parks (a form of protected areas that impose no restrictions on agriculture) to enhance the adoption of biodiversity‐conserving agri‐environment schemes (AES) in Switzerland. Using data from Switzerland's 2023 farm census of 41,307 farms and a survey of 1009 farms from 2023, and accounting for regional landscape and socio‐economic characteristics via matching, we find that the adoption of three types of AES for biodiversity conservation is significantly higher within regional nature parks. To unravel the factors contributing to these differences, we conduct a decomposition analysis to parse out the relative importance of factors influencing AES adoption. We find that higher self‐efficacy regarding biodiversity conservation among farmers within parks explains up to 15% of the difference in AES adoption. Additionally, biodiversity goals by cantonal authorities play a key role. These findings suggest that enhancing farmers' perceived control over conservation practices and designing stronger pro‐biodiversity policies at regional levels could boost AES adoption, both within and outside park regions. For regions not designated as parks, agencies such as extension services could take up the role of fostering farmers' self‐efficacy regarding biodiversity‐conserving practices.
abstract_zh: 摘要 理解目标重叠的政策工具如何相互作用对于发挥其协同效应至关重要。本研究探讨了区域自然公园（一种对农业不施加限制的保护区形式）在瑞士促进生物多样性保护型农业环境计划（AES）采纳的机制。利用瑞士2023年41,307个农场的农业普查数据及2023年1,009个农场的调查数据，并通过匹配方法控制区域景观和社会经济特征，我们发现，在区域自然公园内，三类用于生物多样性保护的AES采纳率显著更高。为揭示造成这些差异的因素，我们进行了分解分析，以解析影响AES采纳的各因素的相对重要性。研究发现，公园内农民对生物多样性保护的自效能感较高，这解释了AES采纳差异中高达15%的部分。此外，州级当局设定的生物多样性目标也发挥着关键作用。这些发现表明，增强农民对保护实践的控制感，并在区域层面制定更强有力的生物多样性支持政策，可促进公园内外地区的AES采纳。对于未被指定为公园的区域，推广服务等机构可承担起培养农民对生物多样性保护实践自效能感的角色。

title: Long panel studies of small-scale rural societies in the Global South: What is their value, why are they rare, and suggestions to make them happen
title_zh: 全球南方小规模农村社会的长期面板研究：其价值、稀缺原因及推进建议
title_primary: 全球南方小规模农村社会的长期面板研究：其价值、稀缺原因及推进建议
title_secondary: Long panel studies of small-scale rural societies in the Global South: What is their value, why are they rare, and suggestions to make them happen
authors: Jonathan Bauchet, Ricardo Godoy, William R. Leonard, Victoria Reyes-García, Asher Y. Rosinger 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Many topics in the behavioral sciences and epidemiology require researchers to directly observe entities (e.g., individuals, households) over a long time to identify lasting effects. Long-term panel data collection is more common in high-income countries than in small-scale rural societies (SSRS) of low-income countries. SSRS are mobile, nature-dependent, linguistic minorities, and highly autarkic. Analyzing such data using a life-course perspective can help uncover patterns that align or upend what we know from high-income countries. This study a) reviews long (>∼10 year) panels in SSRS (n = 9), b) extends the analysis to cover somewhat comparable societies of smallholders (n = 7) who are less autarkic, and c) draws on annual panel data (2002–2010) from one SSRS in the Bolivian Amazon (Tsimane’) to illustrate how adult life-course patterns may vary but also resemble patterns in high-income countries. In general, panels have focused more on human biology than on socioeconomic outcomes, have gathered data at irregular intervals, and have not deposited datasets in public repositories. Compared with people in high-income countries, Tsimane’ were similar in the amount of intragenerational immobility at the very top and the very bottom of the income and wealth distribution. In both places, body weight rose while sociality frayed over time. Yet Tsimane’ differed in having more economic mobility outside the top and bottom income and wealth distribution, a slightly higher growth rate in economic inequality, and no correlation between economic mobility and age. We identify institutional and individual hurdles to collecting panel data in SSRS and discuss steps to overcome them.
abstract_zh: 行为科学与流行病学中的许多议题要求研究者长期直接观察实体（如个体、家庭）以识别持久效应。长期面板数据的收集在高收入国家比在低收入国家的小规模农村社会（SSRS）更为普遍。SSRS具有流动性强、依赖自然、语言少数群体及高度自给自足的特点。运用生命历程视角分析此类数据，有助于揭示与高收入国家已知模式相符或相悖的规律。本研究a）回顾了SSRS中长期（约>10年）面板研究（n=9），b）将分析扩展至较为相似但自给程度较低的小农社会（n=7），c）利用玻利维亚亚马逊地区Tsimane’人（2002-2010年）的年度面板数据，说明成人生命历程模式可能存在的差异及其与高收入国家模式的相似之处。总体而言，这些面板研究更侧重于人类生物学而非社会经济结果，数据收集间隔不规律，且未将数据集存入公共存储库。与高收入国家人群相比，Tsimane’人在收入和财富分布的最顶端及最底端表现出相似的代内流动性缺失程度。两地均出现体重增加而社会交往随时间减少的现象。然而，Tsimane’人的不同之处在于，在收入和财富分布顶端与底端之外存在更高的经济流动性，经济不平等增长率略高，且经济流动性与年龄之间无相关性。我们识别了在SSRS中收集面板数据的制度性和个体性障碍，并讨论了克服这些障碍的步骤。

title: Do Governance Practices in Cluster Farming Improve Wheat Farmers' Profitability? Evidence From Ethiopia
title_zh: 集群农业中的治理实践是否提高了小麦农户的盈利能力？来自埃塞俄比亚的证据
title_primary: 集群农业中的治理实践是否提高了小麦农户的盈利能力？来自埃塞俄比亚的证据
title_secondary: Do Governance Practices in Cluster Farming Improve Wheat Farmers' Profitability? Evidence From Ethiopia
authors: Xiuguang Bai, Yuming Li, Amenu Leta Duguma, Gemedo Furo, Tesfaye Solomon 等
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-05-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Cluster farming has been promoted as an institutional strategy to improve smallholder productivity, market access and profitability in developing countries. However, empirical evidence on the association between governance practices and wheat profitability within cluster systems remains limited. This study examines the role of governance practices on the profitability of wheat farmers in Ethiopia, placing particular emphasis on the mediating role of farm‐gate selling prices. Using cross‐sectional data from 759 farmers across 11 clusters, governance dimension indices were constructed using principal component analysis, and effects were estimated using two‐stage least squares, three‐stage least squares and quantile regression. Results show that accountability, participation and conflict resolution have positive and significant effects on wheat profitability, while transparency has a negative association, likely reflecting coordination and compliance costs. Mediation analysis reveals that farm‐gate price explains about 89.5% of governance's total effect on profitability. Governance effects also vary by cluster group, landholding size, input use and profitability levels. Strong governance improves bargaining power, price realisation and economic returns. The findings highlight the importance of institutional quality in cluster farming. Strengthening accountability, participation and conflict resolution can significantly improve profitability and support smallholder livelihoods, offering key policy insights for cluster‐based agricultural development in Ethiopia and similar contexts.
abstract_zh: 集群农业已被推广为一种制度性策略，旨在提升发展中国家小农户的生产力、市场准入和盈利能力。然而，关于集群体系内治理实践与小麦盈利能力之间关联的实证证据仍然有限。本研究考察了治理实践对埃塞俄比亚小麦农户盈利能力的作用，特别关注农场交货销售价格的中介效应。利用来自11个集群759名农户的横截面数据，通过主成分分析法构建了治理维度指数，并采用两阶段最小二乘法、三阶段最小二乘法及分位数回归估计效应。结果表明，问责制、参与度和冲突解决对小麦盈利能力具有显著正向影响，而透明度则呈现负向关联，这很可能反映了协调与合规成本。中介分析显示，农场交货价格解释了治理对盈利能力总效应的约89.5%。治理效应还因集群组别、土地持有规模、投入品使用及盈利水平而异。强有力的治理能够提升议价能力、价格实现水平及经济回报。研究结果凸显了制度质量在集群农业中的重要性。加强问责制、参与度和冲突解决可显著改善盈利能力并支持小农户生计，为埃塞俄比亚及类似情境下的集群农业发展提供了关键政策启示。

title: Inputs in distress: Geoeconomic fragmentation and firms’ sourcing
title_zh: 困境中的投入：地缘经济分裂与企业的采购来源
title_primary: 困境中的投入：地缘经济分裂与企业的采购来源
title_secondary: Inputs in distress: Geoeconomic fragmentation and firms’ sourcing
authors: Ludovic Panon, Laura Lebastard, Michele Mancini, Alessandro Borin, Peonare Caka Tofani 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the short-run economic impact of unanticipated disruptions to inputs potentially critical for domestic production and the green transition, and prone to geopolitical weaponisation (Foreign Critical Inputs - FCIs). Using firm-level customs and balance-sheet data for Belgium, France, Italy, Slovenia, and Spain, we find that a 50% reduction in FCI imports from China-aligned countries could lead to an average decline in manufacturing value added of 2.7% across the five countries. The impact, however, is highly uneven across firms, sectors, and regions. These findings highlight that supply disruptions in FCIs can impose substantial short-run economic costs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了意外中断对国内生产和绿色转型可能至关重要、且易受地缘政治武器化影响的关键外国投入品（Foreign Critical Inputs - FCIs）的短期经济影响。利用比利时、法国、意大利、斯洛文尼亚和西班牙的企业层面海关及资产负债表数据，我们发现，从与中国结盟国家进口的FCI减少50%，可能导致五国制造业增加值平均下降2.7%。然而，这一影响在企业、行业和地区之间高度不均。这些发现凸显了FCI供应中断可能带来显著的短期经济成本。

title: Market Shares as a Collusive Marker: Evidence From the European Truck Industry
title_zh: 市场份额作为合谋标志：来自欧洲卡车行业的证据
title_primary: 市场份额作为合谋标志：来自欧洲卡车行业的证据
title_secondary: Market Shares as a Collusive Marker: Evidence From the European Truck Industry
authors: Andreas Bovin, Iwan Bos
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Collusion theory robustly predicts non-cartel rivals will raise their prices and increase their output. As a typical cartel cuts back production, its competitors are expected to gain market share during the collusive period and to lose market share in the period following the cartel's demise. We provide empirical support for this prediction by showing that it applies to the European truck cartel. We also illustrate how our analysis can be used in the prosecution stage. One truck manufacturer denied cartel participation, whereas the proposed market share test supports the European Commission's finding that this firm was, in fact, a member.
abstract_zh: 合谋理论稳健地预测，非卡特尔竞争对手将提高价格并增加产量。由于典型卡特尔削减生产，其竞争对手预计在合谋期间获得市场份额，并在卡特尔瓦解后的时期失去市场份额。我们通过证明这一预测适用于欧洲卡车卡特尔，为其提供了实证支持。我们还展示了我们的分析如何在起诉阶段得到应用。一家卡车制造商否认参与卡特尔，而所提出的市场份额检验支持了欧盟委员会关于该公司实际上是成员的认定。

title: The Legacy of Policy Inaction in Climate‐Growth Models
title_zh: 气候增长模型中政策不作为的遗留影响
title_primary: 气候增长模型中政策不作为的遗留影响
title_secondary: The Legacy of Policy Inaction in Climate‐Growth Models
authors: Thomas Steger, Timo Trimborn
official: 官方在线 2026-02-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To better understand the structure and core mechanisms of a broad class of climate-growth models, we study a simplified version of the dynamic integrated model of climate and the economy (DICE) through the lens of growth theory. We analytically show that this model features a continuum of saddle-point stable steady states. Initial conditions of stock variables, which are notoriously difficult to calibrate, matter for long-run economic and climate outcomes. However, we also demonstrate that a misspecified initial stock of capital has a significantly smaller impact than a misspecified initial CO2 stock. These insights have important implications for the consequences of delayed climate policy implementation and the optimal carbon tax. Using a calibrated version of the model, solved numerically for the big transition, we show that postponing optimal climate policy raises both peak temperature and the steady-state temperature. The findings extend to a large set of analytical and numerical integrated assessment models. The simple DICE, augmented by the finite amplitude impulse-response (FAIR) carbon cycle model, exhibits a continuum of steady states over time horizons spanning several centuries. Peak and long-run temperatures depend on initial conditions, a result that is also confirmed for DICE-2023. We further show that the social cost of carbon to GDP ratio is largely constant despite transitional dynamics; however, its level depends on the timing of optimal policy implementation.
abstract_zh: 为深入理解一类广泛的气候-增长模型的结构与核心机制，我们通过增长理论的视角，研究了一个简化版的气候与经济动态综合模型（DICE）。我们分析性地证明，该模型具有连续统的鞍点稳定稳态。存量变量的初始条件，这些通常难以校准的因素，对长期经济与气候结果具有重要影响。然而，我们也展示了，初始资本存量的错误设定对结果的影响显著小于初始CO2存量的错误设定。这些见解对延迟气候政策实施的后果及最优碳税具有重要启示。利用模型的校准版本，通过数值求解大转型过程，我们表明，推迟最优气候政策会同时提高峰值温度和稳态温度。这些发现可推广至大量分析性和数值性的综合评估模型。简单DICE模型，辅以有限振幅脉冲响应（FAIR）碳循环模型，在跨越数个世纪的时间范围内展现出连续统的稳态。峰值温度和长期温度依赖于初始条件，这一结果在DICE-2023中也得到了证实。我们进一步表明，尽管存在转型动态，碳的社会成本与GDP之比大体保持恒定；然而，其水平取决于最优政策实施的时间安排。

title: The Price and Emissions Effects of Extending Nuclear Lifetimes: Evidence from Spain
title_zh: 延长核电站寿命的价格与排放效应：来自西班牙的证据
title_primary: 延长核电站寿命的价格与排放效应：来自西班牙的证据
title_secondary: The Price and Emissions Effects of Extending Nuclear Lifetimes: Evidence from Spain
authors: Natalia Fabra
official: 官方在线 2026-01-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: As Spain approaches the first scheduled nuclear retirements — most notably, Almaraz in 2027 — the debate over the implications of delaying the nuclear phase-out has reopened. This paper uses detailed simulations of the Iberian electricity market to assess the consequences of postponing Almaraz’s closure on wholesale electricity prices, renewable and storage profitability, and power-sector CO2 emissions. We test the robustness of our findings to alternative investment targets, electricity demand paths, and gas marginal costs. We caution against a purely static assessment: while extending Almaraz, holding everything else equal, lowers prices and emissions by displacing gas, it also depresses renewables’ captured prices and increases curtailment, weakening incentives to invest in renewables and storage. If the investment response is large enough, a delayed nuclear phase-out may ultimately lead to higher prices and higher emissions. This article was prepared as the Presidential Address for my term as President of the Spanish Economic Association (2023–2024). I thank Lorenzo Cattabriga, Álvaro Oballe, Elena Parra for their outstanding research support. Views and opinions expressed are, however, those of the author only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Research Council or Redeia. Neither of them can be held responsible for the results reported in this paper. The author declares that this work has been carried out independently, and that she has no financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the findings reported in this paper.
abstract_zh: 随着西班牙首批核电站退役计划临近——尤其是阿尔马拉兹核电站将于2027年关停——关于延迟核能退出影响的辩论再度升温。本文通过伊比利亚电力市场的详细模拟，评估推迟阿尔马拉兹核电站关停对批发电价、可再生能源与储能盈利性以及电力行业二氧化碳排放的影响。我们通过调整投资目标、电力需求路径和天然气边际成本，检验研究结果的稳健性。我们提醒避免纯静态评估：虽然延长阿尔马拉兹核电站运行（在其他条件不变的情况下）可通过替代天然气降低电价和排放，但这同时会压低可再生能源的捕获电价并增加弃电率，削弱投资可再生能源与储能的激励。若投资响应足够显著，延迟核能退出最终可能导致电价上升和排放增加。本文系我担任西班牙经济协会主席（2023-2024年）期间的主席致辞。感谢Lorenzo Cattabriga、Álvaro Oballe、Elena Parra的杰出研究支持。Fabra获得欧盟慷慨资助（ERC项目《能源转型》，编号101142583）。撰写本文时，Natalia Fabra担任Redeia公司独立董事会成员。但本文所述观点仅代表作者个人立场，不代表欧洲研究理事会或Redeia公司立场。上述机构均不对本文报告结果承担责任。作者声明本研究独立完成，且不存在可能影响本文研究结论的财务或个人利益冲突。

title: Impact of big data technology application on corporate financing constraints: evidence from Chinese listed companies
title_zh: 大数据技术应用对企业融资约束的影响——来自中国上市公司的证据
title_primary: 大数据技术应用对企业融资约束的影响——来自中国上市公司的证据
title_secondary: Impact of big data technology application on corporate financing constraints: evidence from Chinese listed companies
authors: Haoran Wang, Lei Ye
official: 官方在线 2025-09-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Big data technologies (BDTs) are widely used in the financial industry due to their ability to quickly integrate and analyse large datasets. However, the effect of BDTs on corporate financing constraints (FCs) remains underexplored. Using data on Chinese listed companies from 2016 to 2022, this study explores the influence of BDT applications on corporate FCs. Results indicate that BDT applications alleviate corporate FCs. Heterogeneity tests show that BDTs more effectively reduce FCs for non-state-owned firms than those for state-owned firms, and for firms in central and western China compared with those for firms in the eastern region. Mechanism tests indicate that BDTs reduce FCs by improving information control, attracting analyst coverage, and increasing institutional investment. These findings contribute to the existing literature on corporate FCs and offer novel insights into avenues for narrowing the financing gap in China.
abstract_zh: 大数据技术（BDTs）因其快速整合与分析大规模数据集的能力，在金融行业中得到广泛应用。然而，BDTs对企业融资约束（FCs）的影响仍未得到充分探讨。本研究利用2016年至2022年中国上市公司的数据，探讨了BDT应用对企业融资约束的影响。结果表明，BDT应用缓解了企业的融资约束。异质性检验显示，与非国有企业相比，BDTs对国有企业融资约束的缓解作用更为显著；与东部地区企业相比，对中西部地区企业的融资约束缓解作用更为明显。机制检验表明，BDTs通过提升信息控制、吸引分析师关注及增加机构投资来降低融资约束。这些发现为现有关于企业融资约束的文献做出了贡献，并为缩小中国融资缺口提供了新颖的视角。

title: Free-riding Yankees: Canada and the Panama Canal
title_zh: 搭便车的美国佬：加拿大与巴拿马运河
title_primary: 搭便车的美国佬：加拿大与巴拿马运河
title_secondary: Free-riding Yankees: Canada and the Panama Canal
authors: Sebastian Galiani, Luis F. Jaramillo, Mateo Uribe-Castro
official: 官方在线 2025-03-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the impact of the Panama Canal on the development of Canada’s manufacturing sector from 1900 to 1939. Using newly digitized county-level data from the Census of Manufactures and a market-access approach, we exploit the plausibly exogenous nature of this historical episode to study how changes in transportation costs influence the process of structural transformation and manufacturing productivity. Our reduced-form estimates show that lowered shipping costs increased manufacturing employment as a share of the population by increasing the number of manufacturing establishments, though not their average size, capital intensity, or skilled labor share. Manufacturing revenues grew 9% more in counties with market access gains at the 75th percentile, compared to counties with 25th percentile gains. Productivity grew by 13% more. These effects persist when we consider general equilibrium effects: the closure of the Canal in 1939 would result in economic losses equivalent to 1.86% of GDP, chiefly as a by-product of the restriction of the country’s access to international markets. Altogether, these results suggest that the Canal substantially altered the economic geography of the Western Hemisphere in the first half of the twentieth century.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了1900年至1939年间巴拿马运河对加拿大制造业发展的影响。利用新数字化的县级制造业普查数据及市场可达性方法，我们借助这一历史事件的准外生性特征，探讨运输成本变化如何影响结构转型过程与制造业生产率。简化形式估计表明，航运成本降低通过增加制造业企业数量（而非企业平均规模、资本密集度或熟练劳动力占比）提升了制造业就业人口比重。在市场可达性增益处于第75百分位的县，制造业收入比第25百分位的县多增长9%，生产率多增长13%。考虑一般均衡效应后，这些影响依然存在：1939年运河关闭将导致相当于GDP 1.86%的经济损失，主要源于该国国际市场准入受限的副产品。综上，这些结果表明，运河在20世纪上半叶显著改变了西半球的经济地理格局。

title: Incorporating Uncertainty in the Economic Evaluation of Capital Investments for Water Use Efficiency Improvements
title_zh: 不确定性纳入水资源利用效率改进资本投资的经济评估
title_primary: 不确定性纳入水资源利用效率改进资本投资的经济评估
title_secondary: Incorporating Uncertainty in the Economic Evaluation of Capital Investments for Water Use Efficiency Improvements
authors: Adamson, D., Loch, A.
official: 官方在线 2021-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Long run investments in water-use efficiency are risky, particularly where water is required as a secure input. State of nature representations of supply outcomes provide an increased understanding of the vulnerability of capital, and water users, to adverse events. Using Californian data, we couple cost–benefit analysis to a state contingent analysis approach to explore the riskiness of water-use efficiency investment payoffs and cash-flow outcomes when frequencies of states of nature change over the investment course. Critically, this allows us to represent decision-maker adaptation in the face of risk and uncertainty, and the role that subsidy policy plays in those decisions. abstract_zh: 长期在水资源利用效率方面的投资存在风险，尤其是在水资源作为必需投入品的情况下。对供应结果的自然状态表示，有助于加深对资本及用水户面对不利事件脆弱性的理解。利用加利福尼亚州的数据，我们将成本效益分析与状态依存分析方法相结合，探讨当自然状态频率在投资过程中发生变化时，水资源利用效率投资回报及现金流结果的风险性。关键在于，这使我们能够刻画决策者在面对风险与不确定性时的适应行为，以及补贴政策在这些决策中所扮演的角色。JEL分类号：D81，Q25，Q54。本开放获取文章依据CC-BY-NC-ND许可协议（http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0）分发，并可在以下网址免费在线获取：http://le.uwpress.org。

title: The Economics of Platforms: A Theory Guide for Competition Policy
title_zh: 平台经济学：竞争政策理论指南
title_primary: 平台经济学：竞争政策理论指南
title_secondary: The Economics of Platforms: A Theory Guide for Competition Policy
authors: Bruno Jullien, Wilfried Sand-Zantman
official: 官方在线 2020-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We propose an analysis of platform competition based on the academic literature with a view toward competition policy. First, we discuss to which extent competition can emerge in digital markets and show which forms it can take. In particular, we underline the role of dynamics, but also of platform differentiation, consumers multihoming and beliefs to allow competition in platform markets. Second, we analyze competition policy issues and discuss how rules designed for standard markets can perform in two-sided markets. We show that multi-sided externalities create new opportunities for anti-competitive conducts, often related to pricing and contractual imperfections.
abstract_zh: 我们基于学术文献提出平台竞争分析，旨在为竞争政策提供参考。首先，探讨数字市场中竞争产生的可能性及其表现形式，特别强调动态因素、平台差异化、消费者多归属行为及市场预期在促进平台市场竞争中的作用。其次，分析竞争政策议题，讨论为标准市场设计的规则如何适用于双边市场。研究表明，多边外部性为反竞争行为创造了新机会，这些行为通常与定价和合同缺陷相关。
